theory.intro: Build a table, identify the Cartesian curve and mark the direction of increasing parameter.
facts: Each parameter value gives one ordered pair.
The Cartesian equation alone may describe more of the curve than the parameter interval allows.
Mark included endpoints with filled dots and excluded endpoints with open dots.
steps: Sketch the selected curve and direction

workedExample.question_text:
For $x=t+2,\ y=t^2-1$:
(a) Complete the table.
$\begin{array}{c|ccccc}t&-2&-1&0&1&2\\x&&&&&\\y&&&&&\end{array}$
(b) Eliminate $t$ and sketch the curve.
Mark the direction of increasing $t$.
